_meta.purpose: Defines the AssemblyAI provider fallback chain used by EntropIA Lite transcription. Loaded once at startup; bundled so dictation still works offline.
_meta.remote_update_policy: This file is bundled with the app and works offline. A future release may additionally fetch a remote copy from the official EntropIA Lite repo, cache it locally, and fall back to this bundled copy offline. The Rust loader rejects any field whose name smells like a credential (api_key, apikey, api-key, token, secret, password) so a remote copy can never smuggle user keys.
_meta.adding_a_new_schema: Append a new entry to providers.assemblyai.schemas in priority order (current first). Each entry needs a stable `name` (used in logs) and a `kind` matching one of the variants the Rust code knows how to serialize. New wire shapes require adding a new SchemaKind variant in transcription/assemblyai/config.rs.
_meta.tested_with_assemblyai_api_version: OpenAPI POST /v2/transcript, speech_models field per official docs.
